title: Angoche–Portuguese conflicts (1847–1910)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Angoche–Portuguese conflicts (1847–1910)", at revision 1370105014, opens: "The Angoche–Portuguese conflicts were a series of wars between the Angoche Sultanate and the Portuguese Empire between 1847 and 1910." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q124022858, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
